name: Week 17 Legs — Steady State, Station-Grouped (Spotlight: Squat Depth + Incline RDL)
description: Volume steady, station-grouped. Squat holds at 80/side with the 6/7/8/8 rep volume — keep building the reps back toward 8/8 at this load; reps are the progression lever, not heavier weight. Leg press holds at 4 plates with the deep knees-to-chest ROM as the priority. Spotlights cycle forward to the squat (depth under the stepped-up load) and the incline RDL (the dead-slow hinge where tempo is the whole progression). Leg curl stays before incline RDL so the two hamstring lifts don't stack. Bulgarian holds its load.

dayOverview.theme: Steady state, station-grouped. Squat holds 80 / 6-7-8-8 (build the reps back, keep the depth); leg press holds 4 plates, deep ROM first. Squat depth + incline RDL get the spotlight refresh — squat for holding depth at 80, incline RDL for the dead-slow hinge. Leg curl before incline RDL so the hamstring work doesn't stack.

spotlights.why: Cycles forward — at the stepped-up 80 the job is holding the same depth that ran clean at 75 while the reps build back to 8/8. Spotlight drills the brace + hips-back-and-down + sit-into-the-bottom so depth leads and the load follows.

Cycles forward — the dead-slow hinge where tempo, not load, is the progression. Spotlight drills the pad-below-the-hip-crease placement + the hamstring/glute stretch (not lower back) + the 3s eccentric / 2s bottom pause at the 45lb plate.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W15 leg press + Bulgarian · W16 leg curl + calf raise · W17 squat depth + incline RDL (current) · W18 cycle forward — leg press ROM + Bulgarian refresh.
watchpoints: **Loads** — squat 80/side (6-7-8-8), leg press 4 plates (ROM first), calf raise 4 plates, leg curl 90, incline RDL 45lb plate, Bulgarian two 40lb DBs (one per hand).

**Squat holds 80 / 6-7-8-8.** Keep building the reps back toward 8/8 at this load — reps are the progression lever, not heavier weight. Keep the depth; if the bottom shortens to make the number, ease back.
**Station-grouped sequence:** warmup → squat → leg press → leg-press-calf-raise (SAME machine, stay there) → Bulgarian (bench station) → leg curl → incline RDL → cool-down. No backtracking.
**Keep leg curl BEFORE incline RDL.** Reversed, the two hamstring lifts stack and smoke the second — keep the prescribed order.
**Bulgarian holds two 40lb DBs** — one per hand. If anything twitches/spasms, drop to bodyweight and finish — the standing rule on this lift.
**QL/psoas watch** — cross-leg lateral lean in the warmup AND cool-down. If anything talks in the warmup, modify the day; mid-session, drop a set.

sets.name: Warmup (incl. Cross-Leg Lateral Lean — QL/Psoas Release)

exercises.notes: Full depth, slow. Find where the hips are tight and breathe into it. Depth check before loading.

30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — the stretch runs down the side of the waist into the QL and lateral hip. Do this before loading the squat.
Big slow circles. Wake up the hip stabilizers.

Back to a wall, heels a step out, weight on the heels. Pull the toes UP toward the shins as high as they'll go, lower slow. Wakes up the shins (the calf's antagonist), preps ankle dorsiflexion for squat depth, and it's shin insurance for the run-in. ~30s, bodyweight.
Spine mobility — slow, full ROM each direction.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension. Quick posterior-chain and low-back opener before loading the squat.
Bodyweight. QL check — if anything talks here, modify the day. Also previews the Bulgarian pattern.
Set 1: 45/side x8. Set 2: 70/side x6 — heavy-ish primer before 80. Same depth as the working sets — the slightly-lighter-but-still-heavy primer is what's been adding the reps.

**LOAD:** 80/side. 4 sets: **6 / 7 / 8 / 8** — keep building the reps back toward 8/8 at this load; reps are the progression lever, not heavier weight. **Drop the last set (the 4th 8) if it feels heavy or unsteady** — bank 6/7/8 clean rather than grind a shaky 8.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — hold the depth at the stepped-up load:**
- Bar high on the upper traps (NOT the neck), upper-back shelf squeezed
- **Brace like prepping for a punch** — deep belly breath at the top, HOLD through the descent, exhale on the drive up
- **Hips back AND down**, not just down
- **'Spread the floor'** — screw the feet into the ground, knees track over the toes
- **Sit into the bottom** — keep chasing the depth set by set, even as the reps climb
- Drive through the WHOLE foot

**Reflection:** does the bottom depth at 80 match what it was at 75, or does the bottom shorten to make the rep? Depth leads, the reps build back over the coming weeks at this load, the weight waits. If the depth shortens, ease back.

sets.name: Leg Press + Calf Raise Station (Same Machine)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side. The deep knees-to-chest ROM comes first: if 4 plates shortens the ROM or lets the lower back lift off the pad, drop back to 3 plates. ROM is the work; the load follows it.
- **Foot position:** shoulder-width, mid-foot on the platform, slight toe-out
- **Full ROM — knees toward the chest.** This deep position trains the abs/QL/core more than the quads — that's the intent
- **It feels harder cold** — the deep ROM opens up once the hips are warm, so don't judge the load on set 1
- **Actively press to keep the lower back from lifting off the pad** at the bottom; if the hips roll off, back off a hair
- **Press through the WHOLE foot** — heels grounded
- **Slow descent (3s), no bounce at the bottom**
- **Don't lock out hard at the top** — leave a hair of bend. Breath: in on the descent, out on the drive

sets.name: Leg-Press Calf Raise (Same Machine, Stays Right Here)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side. 3 sets of 15. Stay on the leg press — same machine, no walking off.
- **Balls of both feet on the BOTTOM EDGE of the platform, heels hanging off** — the platform edge gives the heel drop
- **Full stretch at the bottom** — let the heels drop as far below the edge as they'll go
- **Drive to FULL plantarflexion at the top**
- **Tempo by feel** — own the stretch at the bottom and the squeeze at the top, no bouncing. Breath continuous.

exercises.equipment: bench + DBs — Smith machine if free (use smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat)
exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** two 40lb DBs, one per hand. 3 sets of 8-10 each leg.
- **Rear foot up on the bench** behind you, laces down or toes tucked
- **Step out far enough that the front shin stays roughly VERTICAL at the bottom** — too short a stance = the knee crashes past the toes
- **Front knee tracks over the front foot** — not caving in
- **Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor** — controlled, no dropping
- **Drive up through the FRONT HEEL** — the front leg does the work, the rear leg is a kickstand
- **Torso TALL** — a slight forward lean is fine, no folding over
- **2s descent**, own the bottom

**Watch:** if anything twitches/spasms, drop to bodyweight for the remaining sets and finish.

sets.name: Seated Leg Curl (3 Sets at 90, Before Incline RDL)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 90. 3 sets of 12, slow tempo.
- **Ankles UNDER the pad** — the ankle bone is the contact point, NOT the mid-calf
- **Settings: 5/m/0/1** (verify before loading)
- **Lap pad locked DOWN firmly** — a loose pad lets the torso lift and turns it into lower-back work
- **Curl the heels toward the glutes** — full ROM, full squeeze
- **2s eccentric, 1s squeeze** — the slow eccentric is the whole stimulus; you feel these deeply when you go slow
- Torso anchored, no lifting forward, no bouncing out of the bottom. This comes BEFORE incline RDL on purpose — take it fresh.

**LOAD:** 45lb plate. 3 sets of 15, dead slow with a 2s pause at the bottom.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the dead-slow hinge where tempo is the progression:**
- **Pad just below the hip crease** — NOT on the upper thigh, NOT on the stomach
- **Hip hinge** — a Romanian deadlift on the 45° bench, NOT a lumbar extension. Lower back NEUTRAL throughout
- **At the bottom:** the stretch is in the **hamstrings and glutes**, NOT the lower back. If the lumbar rounds, you're going too deep for current mobility
- **Drive up by squeezing the glutes and hamstrings**; at the top, stop at neutral — past neutral = lumbar load = QL irritation
- **Tempo: 3s eccentric, 2s pause at the bottom, 1s drive up.** The slow eccentric is the entire reason this lift works — hold the 45lb plate and keep slowing the tempo; don't chase the load

**Reflection:** where's the stretch landing — hamstrings/glutes (correct) or lower back (too deep / pad placement off)? If lower back, slow down further and check the pad before set 2. The tempo is the lift; the number stays.

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Recovery Block (Hip/QL-Biased for Legs Day)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Scissor the legs, reach overhead, lean away from the back leg — bookend the session with the same QL/psoas release as the warmup.
45s each side. Deep hip-flexor and glute release — the long hold lets the QL and psoas let go.
30s each side. Gentle twist for the QL — draw one knee across the body, opposite arm extended.
60s slow breathing. Knees wide, arms extended forward. Parasympathetic shift.

sets.notes: 5-min recovery block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.

tips: **Steady state, station-grouped.** Squat 4 sets, leg press 4, calf raise 3, Bulgarian 3, leg curl 3, incline RDL 3.
**Squat holds 80 / 6-7-8-8** — keep building the reps back toward 8/8; reps are the progression lever, not heavier weight.
**Spotlight: squat depth + incline RDL.** Squat drills holding depth at 80; incline RDL drills the dead-slow hinge at the 45lb plate.
**Station-grouped:** warmup → squat → leg press → leg-press-calf-raise (same machine — stay there) → Bulgarian → leg curl → incline RDL → cool-down. No backtracking.
**Leg curl BEFORE incline RDL** — don't reverse them, or the hamstring work stacks.
**Bulgarian holds two 40lb DBs** — one per hand. Drop to bodyweight if anything twitches.
**Incline RDL is a 45lb plate, dead slow** — the tempo is the progression, not the number.
**Cross-leg lateral lean in the warmup AND cool-down** — QL/psoas release.
**Cool-down stays — 5-min block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.**
Rest: 3 min squats, 2 min leg press, 90s calf raise + Bulgarian + isolations.
formPhilosophy: Steady-state legs week. The squat and incline RDL get the deep-cue treatment: the squat for holding depth at the stepped-up 80 while the reps build back, the incline RDL for the dead-slow hinge where tempo — not load — is the whole progression. The sequence keeps the two hamstring lifts from stacking and the station order from backtracking. Form leads load — building decades, not weeks.
